purpose: Checks output against the failure classes in our own error ledger — things that actually happened here, not generic quality rules.
runsOn: output, never intent. What I meant to do is not evidence.

problems.what: 1 card generator(s) are not in the pipeline: card-composite.mjs
problems.why: Anything that produces a publishable artifact outside the run is a path around every guard. That is how a wrong price reached a card today.
A single pack at that price usually means a multi-pack listing survived the filter. This is error 11, and it is how a whole class of prices got inflated before.

Nothing here can tell whether they LOOK right — clipping, overlap, a wordmark colliding with a stat row. Every card shown to a person must be opened and looked at first. That rule was broken twice today and both failures reached Tyler.

problems.what: 23 fact(s) rest only on secondary sources
problems.why: Sources agreeing with each other is often one source repeated. Anything we can check against our own data must be checked before it is published.

problems.what: build-promo.mjs draws fixed-size text onto a variable-width canvas
problems.why: Text sized for the full canvas vanishes in a feed preview, where the image is actually seen and decided on. Scale to the canvas or the words are decoration.

problems.what: __nt-publish.mjs can publish to X without a human confirmation gate
problems.why: It reaches a posting endpoint but does not both check for an attached terminal and run the confirmation policy. Content posted by automated means is ineligible for the Original Content Rewards program — an unattended send does not save time, it disqualifies the account.
